access.user: Can browse course information. Cannot modify course fact data.
access.admin: Can browse course information. Does not directly modify course facts through ordinary pages.
access.agent: Can read course search and detail capabilities.

rules.stable-entity: A course is a stable course entity and does not represent a specific semester offering.
rules.static-course-identity: Static ingestion stores the upstream Course id unchanged as Course.jwId and upserts only by jwId. Code, names, and classification metadata are mutable attributes and never participate in identity inference. Conflicting codes for one jwId abort; other metadata is selected deterministically from the latest semester occurrence.
rules.static-section-course-link: Each imported Section resolves the upstream Course jwId attached to its lesson parent. Static sync updates courseId on both insert and conflict update; missing Course jwId mappings abort the transaction.
rules.retired-section-history: Direct Course detail retains retired Section offerings as historical references; public Section discovery excludes them.
rules.jwid-url-only: jwId is used only for URLs, APIs, MCP, and backend logic; it should not be directly displayed in ordinary course UI.
rules.education-level-display-casing: English education-level filter labels uppercase only their initial character for consistent display while preserving all remaining source casing; non-English labels remain unchanged.
rules.public-list-cache: Public Course REST responses are deterministic by URL: omitted locale uses canonical zh-cn and locale=en-us selects English. They do not derive output from Cookie or Accept-Language and may use shared CDN caching. REST, GraphQL, and MCP lists share revision-scoped locale/filter/pagination runtime caching. Localized HTML pages use their locale-partitioned SSR cache.
rules.mobile-detail-hierarchy: Course detail pages present the public course code before the localized display name on mobile, use a responsive title size, and use the Detail Two-Column Stream without a context-tab rail.
rules.detail-canonical-url: The canonical course detail URL is `/catalog/courses/[jwId]`. Legacy path segments and `?tab=` deep links permanently redirect to the root; optional hash anchors scroll within the page.
rules.static-classification-unsupported: Static course snapshots do not currently provide CourseClassify source data, so static-loaded courses keep classifyId/classify null and static-loaded metadata may expose courseClassifies as an empty array.
rules.bounded-detail-history: Course detail returns the 20 most recent Section offerings plus the total Section count. Nested teacher references contain only public identity and localized names; contact and private source columns are never embedded.
rules.public-detail-cache: Anonymous REST, MCP, and single-entity GraphQL Course reads share a revision-, locale-, ID-, and response-shape-scoped runtime cache. Missing entities are not cached.

notes: REST page accepts 1-100, pageSize accepts 1-100, and search accepts 2-200 characters; the deprecated limit alias remains accepted and pageSize wins when both are supplied. Out-of-range values are rejected instead of clamped.

queries.name: courses
notes: PageInput defaults to page=1 and pageSize=20; page and pageSize must remain within 1-100, and search within 2-200 characters.

tools.name: catalog_course_search
notes: MCP limit accepts 1-100 and rejects out-of-range values instead of clamping.
sections is a newest-first preview capped at 20 records; _count.sections is the complete historical total.
